name: OAI Electronics Inc
old_description: At OAI our diverse management team and highly experienced production personnel comprise the predictable, competitive and qualified workforce behind OAI Electronics LLC.
about:
OAI Electronics operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, where it runs two environmentally monitored facilities totaling 65,000 square feet. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, describing its workforce as a diverse management team and highly experienced production personnel.

As a build-to-print contract electronics manufacturer, OAI produces circuit card assemblies, flex and rigid-flex assemblies, and electromechanical enclosures. Its capabilities span surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, RF boards, high-temperature assemblies, potting, encapsulation, conformal coating, and system integration, all performed to IPC-A-610 and IPC J-STD-001 Classes 2 and 3.

The company serves the aerospace, military, medical, and industrial sectors, with its ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certification scope explicitly covering printed circuit board assemblies and box builds for those markets.

OAI emphasizes a predictable, competitive, and qualified workforce, blending skilled employees, proven processes, continual improvement, and responsive systems to deliver products on time and to customer specifications. It maintains in-house IPC-certified trainers and complies with NIST 800-171 for controlled unclassified information.
